def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The dividers split the grid into equal-sized panels. Reflect the
    # pattern in the upper-left panel across each divider.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    panel_h, panel_w = 3, 6
    source = [row[:panel_w] for row in grid[:panel_h]]

    for r in range(h):
        if r in (3, 7):
            continue
        band_r = 0 if r < 3 else (1 if r < 7 else 2)
        local_r = r % 4 if band_r == 0 else (r - 4 if band_r == 1 else r - 8)
        for c in range(w):
            if c == 6:
                continue
            band_c = 0 if c < 6 else 1
            local_c = c if band_c == 0 else c - 7
            sr = panel_h - 1 - local_r if band_r % 2 else local_r
            sc = panel_w - 1 - local_c if band_c % 2 else local_c
            out[r][c] = source[sr][sc]
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    # Divider rows/columns are the solid-color lines. The spaces between
    # dividers are equal-sized panels; copy the patterned panel into each.
    divider_rows = [r for r in range(h)
                    if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    divider_cols = [c for c in range(w)
                    if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    row_bounds = [-1] + divider_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + divider_cols + [w]
    panels = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1],
               col_bounds[j] + 1, col_bounds[j + 1])
              for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)
              for j in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]

    # Use the panel with the most non-background cells as the source.
    def panel_data(p):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = p
        vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
        counts = {v: vals.count(v) for v in set(vals)}
        bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
        return vals, bg

    source_panel = max(panels, key=lambda p: sum(
        v != panel_data(p)[1] for v in panel_data(p)[0]))
    r0, r1, c0, c1 = source_panel
    source = [grid[r][c0:c1] for r in range(r0, r1)]

    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for pr0, pr1, pc0, pc1 in panels:
        for i, r in enumerate(range(pr0, pr1)):
            for j, c in enumerate(range(pc0, pc1)):
                out[r][c] = source[i][j]
    return out
